description_en: Synchronizes department information to a group enterprise (parent/subsidiary enterprises)
description_zh: 调用本接口，可实现向集团企业（主/子企业）中同步部门信息
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen group-depart-save --outer-dept-id 1001 --dept-name '测试部门' --status 0 --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GroupDepartSave

parameters.help_en: The department ID. The default root department ID in Alibaba Business Travel is 1. Do not use this value when passing parameters to avoid call failures
parameters.help_zh: 部门 ID，阿里商旅默认企业根部门 ID 为 1，在传入时请勿使用，以避免调用失败
parameters.name: outer_dept_id

parameters.help_en: The parent department ID. The default root department ID in Alibaba Business Travel is 1. Do not use this value when passing parameters to avoid call failures
parameters.help_zh: 父部门 ID，阿里商旅默认企业根部门 ID 为 1，在传入时请勿使用，以避免调用失败
parameters.name: outer_dept_pid

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the department is active. Valid values:
0: Active.
1: Inactive
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The department manager ID.
If the department has multiple managers, pass the values in the format `[manager1|manager2|manager3]`
parameters.help_zh:
部门主管 ID。
当部门存在多位主管时，请参照 `[主管1|主管2|主管3]` 的格式进行传值
parameters.name: manager_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of enterprise IDs to which the department belongs. Required parameter
parameters.help_zh: 部门归属企业 ID 列表，必填参数
parameters.name: sub_corp_id_list

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access token.
When calling this operation over HTTP, include this as a required parameter in the request URL. For information about how to obtain the token, refer to Enterprise access token (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985).
When appending this parameter, use `crop_token=value` instead
parameters.help_zh:
企业访问凭证。
通过 HTTP 方式调用本接口时，需要作为必填参数拼接在请求地址中。获取方式请参见：企业访问凭证 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985)。
在拼接时，推荐使用 `crop_token=value` 代替
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token

code.description_en: The error code. A non-zero value indicates a failed request
code.description_zh: 错误码，非 0 表示请求失败

message.description_en: The failure reason. This parameter is returned only when the request fails
message.description_zh: 请求失败原因，仅请求失败时显示

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request

success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: Successful.
false: Failed

traceId.description_en: The global trace identifier for the request, typically used for troubleshooting and diagnostics
traceId.description_zh: 跟踪请求全局的标识符，通常用于问题的排查与定位
